version.description: The version of this file format

nightFromHour.description: The night is from this hour ...

eat.description: When an NPC stops what it does to eat

below.description: Hunger below this sends an NPC to eat

restore.description: Hunger an NPC gains from a meal

place.description: A named place of the level, or home

dangerPlace.description: Where a person goes when danger or fear strikes

scatterPixels.description: People at the same named place stand within this many pixels of it, not on one spot

activities.description: What each activity does to the needs of an NPC

additionalProperties.description: One entry, named by its key

energy.description: Energy gained each hour of the activity

hunger.description: Hunger restored each hour of the activity

free.description: The activities an NPC picks from when free

maxPerHour.description: At most this many persons choose an action on one hour mark (the budget of ADR-022)

dealings.description: How NPCs deal with each other and with the hero

meetRadius.description: How near two NPCs must be to deal with each other, in pixels (96 is 3 m)

fightRoundsPerHour.description: A fight near the hero: rounds of strike and strike back an hour

farFightRounds.description: A far fight is settled at once, in this many rounds at most

witnessOpinion.description: Witnesses who know the victim think this much less of the attacker

griefOpinion.description: The family of the dead think this much less of the killer

farPercent.description: The chance in a hundred that a far person has a dealing when it is visited (once a day)

preferBonus.description: Added to the score of an action the NPC prefers for the kind of partner it meets

defaultHp.description: Hit points of a fighter with none of its own

defaultDamage.description: Damage of a fighter with none of its own

chatSocial.description: The Social need a conversation gives back to both

chatter.description: Interaction ids NPCs do when they chat
